title: Before you get started
subtitle: A few quick questions to help us understand where you're starting from. This only appears once.

stress.question: In the last 12 months, how often have you experienced stress that affected your ability to work effectively?

presenteeism.question: In the last 12 months, how often have you gone to work despite feeling unwell or below your best, and worked at reduced effectiveness as a result?

absenteeism.question: In the last 12 months, how many days of work have you missed due to stress, burnout, or mental health?

turnoverIntention.question: In the last 12 months, how often have you thought about leaving your job because of stress or workload?
